source_document.body:
Our midweek edition is dominated by electric vehicles, starting with two exclusive deals from Heybike to score $289 savings on its upgraded Mars 2.5 Folding Fat Tire e-bike with a FREE large front basket at a new $799 low or $389 savings on the Ranger S 2.0 Folding Fat Tire e-bike with the same FREE bundle at a new $899 low . We also have a returning low price on BougeRV’s Electric Utility Cart with a 660-pound carrying capacity, as well as a deal for Segway’s budget-friendly E2 Pro Electric Scooter, and more for you below. Don’t forget about yesterday’s hangover deals at the bottom of the page, like the the Segway launch deal for the new E3 Go Electric Scooter , the 4-Day Bluetti Member Sale lineup, and others.
Head below for other New Green Deals we’ve found today and, of course, Electrek ’s best EV buying and leasing deals . Also, check out the new Electrek Tesla Shop for the best deals on Tesla accessories .
Get an exclusive $289 savings on Heybike’s upgraded Mars 2.5 folding e-bike + FREE front basket at new $799 low
Alongside the exclusive Heybike deal on the Ranger S 2.0 e-bike , our readers can also score exclusive savings on the brand’s revamped and upgraded Mars 2.5 Folding Fat Tire e-bike with a FREE large front basket ($89 value) down at $799 shipped , after using the code 9T5T100 at checkout. This is an updated version of the now-discontinued Mars 2.0 that carries a $999 MSRP, which we’ve only seen discounted to $899 up until today. Now, with our exclusive code adding an additional $100 savings to the initial price cut, you’re getting $289 total savings at a new all-time low price, coming in $300 under the Mars 3.0 counterpart .
You can learn all about the Mars 2.5 e-bike’s upgraded features here .
Advertisement - scroll for more content
Save exclusive $389 on Heybike’s Ranger S 2.0 folding e-bike + FREE front basket at a new $899 low
Alongside the exclusive deal we secured from Heybike on the Mars 2.5 e-bike , the brand is also offering our readers an exclusive chance at its other upgraded Ranger S 2.0 Folding Fat Tire e-bike with a FREE larger front basket ($89 value) down at $899 shipped , after using the code 9T5T100 at checkout. Like the Mars 2.5, this is a revamped version of the discontinued Ranger S model that goes for $1,199 at full price and gets an additional $100 discount further with our code from the initial discount to $999. In total, you’re saving an exclusive $389 here, landing it at a new all-time low price and coming in $500 under the newest Ranger 3.0 Pro .
You can learn about this Ranger S 2.0 e-bike’s upgraded features here .
Commute up to 25 miles on Segway’s budget-friendly E2 Pro e-scooter with Apple Find My at $420 ($80 off)
Amazon is currently offering the Segway E2 Pro Electric Scooter down at $419.99 shipped , beating out the brand’s direct website pricing by $80 . Down from $500 here, despite the $600 MSRP direct from Segway, the deal here gives you an $80 markdown off the going rate ($180 off the MSRP) for the third-lowest price we have tracked. It was down at $399 during the recent Prime Day event, with it only sitting $21 higher in price now.
The heavy-duty BougeRV electric utility cart with a 660-pound carrying capacity back at $870 low (Reg. $1,100)
Through its official Amazon storefront, BougeRV is dropping its new Electric Utility Cart back down to $869.99 shipped . It just released onto the market in August with a $1,100 full price, which we saw discounted to this same rate up until the first few days of September, climbing back up in price. At the start of October it fell to $900, where it has remained through Prime Day and up until now, dropping $30 further to land back at the all-time lowest price we have tracked ($230 total savings). If you don’t need the heavy-duty electric support this model provides, you can find the Lightweight Foldable Electric Utility Wagon retaining its first Amazon discount to a $280 low , too.
